extras.textures: PBR 4096px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: railway slewing crane on a 12.0 m bogie wagon, jib 8.0 m at 40 degrees, overall 14.5 m long, 3.4 m wide, 7.5 m high, standard gauge 1435 mm
extras.notes: front faces -Y, origin on the rail top (wheel contact plane); buffer and screw coupling axis 1.05 m above rail top (Cozy Trains kit standard). Wagon: yellow fish belly sills, steel deck, two bogies, folded yellow outriggers with jacks, slewing ring. Movable: the whole yellow slewing superstructure (machinery house with cab windows, roof beacon, A frame, counterweight with warning bands, lattice jib with ropes and red hook block) is the separate object 'rail-crane_jib', origin on the vertical slewing axis (x +0.000, y +1.251, z +1.400 m from the model origin, Z up); rotate about Z (glTF Y) to slew; the cab glass and the beacon are parented to it

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
